item.title: SCP-691
item.content:encoded:
I like this, and feel like it has something unnerving about it, but I'm not sure it's a strong as it could be. For once I think the [REDACTED] and [CLASSIFIED. O5 CLEARANCE REQUIRED] are actually realistic as I have almost no idea what they are actually covering up. Obviously something bad is happening, but what? But What?

Incident with the Dr. exposed to it made it for me. Test logs after that were ok, though didn't really build up to anything IMO. Last one was an interesting request.

True. However, it fits the standard Factory hallmarks:

1) Mass produced.
2) Small.
3) Ordinary object with extraordinary properties.
4) Lack of inherent threat or danger.
5) Anomalous properties only manifest with use.

The combination of it all makes this perfect for the Factory.
